message.title: Another contract Extension for Haven
message.body: Jacktel is pleased to announce that Equinor has extended the Draupner contract by another 6 weeks, until May 27, 2026. Following completion of the Draupner contract, Haven will be mobilized directly to the new location where the 15 month firm charter will commence. As a result, the gap between the two contracts is now fully closed and the backlog increased by approximately USD 7 million.

category.category_en: ADDITIONAL REGULATED INFORMATION REQUIRED TO BE DISCLOSED UNDER THE LAWS OF A MEMBER STATE
